DICETHESPIRE-MANUAL.description: At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:diceIcons()} and draw [blue]1[/blue] [red]less card[/red].
DICETHESPIRE-MANUAL.title: The Manual
DICETHESPIRE-BLUEPRINT.description: At the start of each turn, gain {Energy:diceIcons()} and draw [blue]1[/blue] [red]less card[/red].
DICETHESPIRE-BLUEPRINT.flavor: "I was expecting something more elegant than this..."
DICETHESPIRE-BLUEPRINT.title: The Blueprints
DICETHESPIRE-CARDBOARD_HAT.flavor: "I can't believe the Merchant was just going to throw this away!"
DICETHESPIRE-CARDBOARD_HAT.title: Cardboard Hat
DICETHESPIRE-SPARE_SPECTACLES.descriptio: One unupgraded card will always be offered as [gold]Scrap[/gold].
DICETHESPIRE-SPARE_SPECTACLES.flavor: "Even comes with a case and cleaning cloth!"
DICETHESPIRE-SPARE_SPECTACLES.title: Spare Spectacles
DICETHESPIRE-PORTABLE_FAN.description: Whenever you create a card in combat, apply a random debuff to ALL enemies.
DICETHESPIRE-PORTABLE_FAN.flavor: "God paper pulp smells awful. At least now I'm not the one smelling it."
DICETHESPIRE-PORTABLE_FAN.title: Portable Fan
DICETHESPIRE-TOASTED_MARSHMALLOW.descrip: At the end of your turn, gain [blue]2[/blue] block for each unspent {Energy:diceIcons()}.
DICETHESPIRE-TOASTED_MARSHMALLOW.flavor: "...I don't want to talk about this one."
DICETHESPIRE-TOASTED_MARSHMALLOW.title: Toasted Marshmallow
DICETHESPIRE-ELECTRICAL_GLOVES.descripti: At the end of your turn, [gold]Retain[/gold] ALL [gold]Shocked[/gold] cards.
DICETHESPIRE-ELECTRICAL_GLOVES.flavor: "Not only does this protect my hands, the abrasive texture means I won't keep dropping my stuff!"
DICETHESPIRE-ELECTRICAL_GLOVES.title: Electrical Gloves
DICETHESPIRE-CLOSED_TOE_SHOES.descriptio: At the start of each turn, [gold]Enchant[/gold] a card in hand with [pink]Swift[/pink] [blue]1[/blue].
DICETHESPIRE-CLOSED_TOE_SHOES.flavor: "If I rotate my shoes out after each combat, I might be able to keep my socks dry!"
DICETHESPIRE-CLOSED_TOE_SHOES.title: Closed Toe Shoes
DICETHESPIRE-TOOLBELT.description: [gold]Unplayable[/gold] cards can now be played. Playing an [gold]Unplayable[/gold] card [gold]Blinks[/gold] it.
DICETHESPIRE-TOOLBELT.flavor: "You can never have too many pockets, and a toolbelt is just pockets!"
DICETHESPIRE-TOOLBELT.title: Toolbelt
